verdict.rationale: A live probe shows a versioned production REST API that returns a structured error contract rather than a bot wall [hmrc-probe-1]. The MTD guidance says filing runs through compatible software rather than the web UI [hmrc-docs-10, hmrc-docs-11, hmrc-supp-3], so non-interactive programmatic access exists. However, nothing in the pack shows how unattended or CI use works in practice, and the developer documentation could not be inspected because robots.txt blocks crawlers [hmrc-probe-2]. Missing for 10: documented headless/non-interactive auth flow (e.g. machine credentials without human consent), sandbox/test environment evidence for CI, any CLI or SDK, and hands-on or independent corroboration of automated filing.
